'''Bouni''' (Sumo) is a [[Skou languages|Skou language]] of [[Papua New Guinea]]. It is spoken in Sumo village ({{coord|-3.071192|141.945439|type:city_region:PG|name=Sumo}}) of [[West Aitape Rural LLG]], [[Sandaun Province]], located near the border with Indonesia.
